question: What unintended victims result from ari-siddha and ari-sādhya classifications in hostile rites?
premises: An ari-siddha mantra would kill one's son.
An ari-sādhya mantra would kill one's own wife.
inference: Misclassified hostile applications harm the practitioner's own family members.
plain_english: An ari-siddha mantra would kill one's son, and an ari-sādhya mantra would kill one's own wife.
